reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis incorrectly assumes that a fluorine treatment can induce a protective Al2O3 layer on an alloy that contains no aluminum, making the proposed mechanism physically impossible.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clearly described and would decisively falsify the hypothesis, but it tests an impossible mechanism.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it is based on a fundamental compositional error; the alloy lacks aluminum, so the proposed intervention cannot work as described.
